claude_proposed_widenings.name: MagicItemComponentMechanics.ongoing_effect
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The item's activated property is not immediate spell access or a one-shot direct phase. It creates temporary armed state that persists on the weapon until a later hit or timeout.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "You can take a Bonus Action to magically coat the blade with poison. The poison remains for 1 minute or until an attack using this weapon hits a creature."
